thread:
liam (AE): quick heads-up — Procyon SatCom just escalated their go-live window. they need a firm plan for private deploy + SLA by end of Q3 :exclamation:

maria (PM): what are the must-haves from their side? scope/okrs?

liam (AE): summary from call:
- private deployment (VPC) in eu-west-1
- brought-your-own-KMS + audit logs
- model pinning to a quantized variant (for throughput)
- throughput: sustained 600 rps at avg payload size (~120 tokens)
- latency target: p95 < 350ms (soft), p99 < 1.2s (hard)
- rollout date request: target customer acceptance test start 2025-11-15

sophie (Eng Lead): ok real constraints: 600 rps sustained is non-trivial for a private pool. need details on concurrency profile and seq length distribution. can they tolerate burst-to-dedicated fallback?

liam (AE): they said most requests are short (avg 90-150 tokens), but spikes during telemetry ingestion windows. willing to accept burst fallback to hosted for 5–10% of traffic during peak if we document it.

maria (PM): prioritize launch criteria — what do we need to call this "enterprise private GA" for Procyon?

sophie (Eng Lead): propose minimal launch checklist: 
- infra: 2x reserved pools (eu-west-1) with autoscale headroom (config below)
- model: pinned quantized model + verified eval pass on procyon's prompt set
- security: KMS integration + audit logging to their SIEM
- perf: canary that proves p95 < 350ms for 7 continuous days under 80% expected load
- fallback: documented fallback policy and runbook

raj (Solutions): adding commercial ask — they want SLA language for latency and a runbook for incident response (15 min P1 ack). also a capacity commitment figure for billing.

maria (PM): thanks. can we map to who owns each item + rough lead times?

sophie (Eng Lead): i'll own infra & perf validations. rough estimate: baseline infra + tests -> 3 weeks, quant model onboarding -> 2 weeks (assuming model vetting passes), end-to-end canary -> 1 week. overall ~6 weeks if no major blockers.

raj (Solutions): i'll handle kms/legal checklist with their security contacts. expect back-and-forth, estimate 2 weeks to finalize KMS/HSM details.

tia (CS): i'll coordinate customer-facing acceptance criteria and test cases. can they provide a small traffic replay for perf testing?

liam (AE): they can give a 48-hour replay extract next week. they prefer a strict cutover (no rolling back to hosted) but ok with documented fallback if problems.

maria (PM): this puts target start 2025-11-15 for customer acceptance — to hit that, internal schedule needs to start by 2025-10-01. can we commit?

sophie (Eng Lead): we can aim for that if infra procurement and A100 allocation are approved by 2025-10-03. need eng-infra ticket + capacity reserve. also need confirmation on model quantization approach (8-bit vs 4-bit) — 4-bit saves more but requires eval acceptance.

liam (AE): i'll push customer to accept 8-bit as initial and approve 4-bit pilot later.

maria (PM): decision log: 
- milestone A (2025-10-03): infra reservation & procurement done
- milestone B (2025-10-17): model pinned & quantized baseline validated on their prompts
- milestone C (2025-11-01): private deploy + canary kickoff
- milestone D (2025-11-15): customer acceptance test start

sophie (Eng Lead): FYI sample deploy config for planning (dev only):
```
private_deploy:
  region: eu-west-1
  pool_size: 2
  instance_type: a100-80gb
  model: redwood-rt-7b-quant-8bit
  autoscale:
    max_replicas: 6
    target_util: 0.6
  monitoring:
    p95_latency_slo_ms: 350
    p99_latency_slo_ms: 1200
```

raj (Solutions): that looks good as a starting point. we should add logging -> splunk endpoint + SIEM keys placeholder.

deploy-bot: scheduled reservation created: request-id rsv-20251102-87321 (pending capacity approval)

maria (PM): action items: @sophie open infra ticket + attach capacity numbers; @raj start KMS/contract thread; @tia request traffic replay; @liam confirm customer accepts initial 8-bit plan. I'll sync with sales/legal on SLA wording.

liam (AE): will confirm 8-bit tonight and ask for replay next Tues.

sophie (Eng Lead): i'll open ENG-INF ticket by EOD and ping infra for allocate.

tia (CS): i'll draft acceptance test cases and share by Friday.

maria (PM): thanks team. i'll update the external commitment doc and flag this as "high priority — top account". next sync Wed 10am PT. :thumbsup:

liam (AE): thanks all.
